## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.21.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.21.1.pdf** |
| Controls and rules on one sheet, two-sided, to keep by the keyboard | **Cognitive-Terrain-Quick-Reference-0.21.1.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.21.1.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.21 build (0.21.0, 0.21.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **A less one-track Standard opponent.** Red no longer hammers one area all
  campaign: when three weeks on an area have gained it nothing it moves to
  another, and the longer it stays on one, the more it looks elsewhere. Once it
  falls clearly behind on Decision Health it defends harder, so taking the
  initiative no longer decides the game on the spot. Veteran and Elite, which
  already move their aim between crises, are unchanged.
- **Tabs in their side's colours.** INFLUENCE (SHAPE in Military words) is
  framed in red and PROTECT (DEFEND) in blue, like the attack and defence
  cards.
